title: Musical Bingo at The Cabot in Beverly
description: Songs and artists take the place of bingo numbers in this music game, with rounds organized by decade, genre and theme. Players listen for a match, mark their cards and aim for five in a row.

title: Teen Fall Program Graduation: Night Two at ZUMIX Firehouse
description: ZUMIX’s December 11 showcase is billed as a presentation of young people’s semester work. The listing gives the evening’s hours but does not name Night Two’s projects or performance formats.

title: Brew to the People: A Coffeehouse Conversation at Tudor Place
description: On Dec. 10, 2026, Tudor Place uses colonial coffeehouse culture to frame open conversation around a Martha Washington exhibition.

title: Passim Monday Discovery Series: Songwriters in the Round at Club Passim
description: The December edition is listed as a songwriter round, but its performers are still TBA. The event is dated Tuesday, Dec. 8, despite the Monday in the series name.

title: Keon Polee Stand-Up at The Cellar At The Comedy Loft of DC, Dec. 10–12, 2026
description: TicketSmarter lists a 7:30 p.m. show each night, with additional 9:45 p.m. performances on Friday and Saturday. Washington.org confirms the run but directs readers to the event website for times.

title: Avery Anna Concert at The Fillmore Silver Spring — Dec. 11, 2026
description: A look at the fan-informed album behind “Mr. Predictable,” Anna’s country writing and what is—and isn’t—announced for the Silver Spring concert.

title: Lexus Global Lacrosse Women’s Session 4: Two Sixes Games in Springfield
description: On Dec. 11, 2026, the women’s Session 4 doubleheader at The St. James opens with Australia vs. the Haudenosaunee Nationals, then brings the United States and Canada together.

title: Festival of Laughs: Eitan Levine — Hanukkah Comedy at DC Improv
description: DC Improv’s annual Hanukkah show falls on the holiday’s seventh night and welcomes attendees whether or not they are Jewish. General admission starts at $29.50, with a separate mandatory two-item minimum per customer.

title: Canadian Brass Concert at The Cabot: Dec. 21, 2026
description: The five-player brass quintet brings a repertoire that ranges across Baroque music, Dixieland, jazz, opera and new arrangements. The listing names the musicians and a broad musical scope, but not the works planned for this concert.

title: Desert Sol Festival 2027 at Desert Botanical Garden
description: Six festival weekends pair garden-wide live music with rotating desert activities, food options and the Super Bloom art installation. The Garden’s listing sets the hours but not a performer lineup or day-by-day activity schedule.

title: Look up for Felix the Cat
description: The 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade moves to Saturday, November 28, 2026. See the New York route, new TV times and returning balloons.

title: Across to Bainbridge on foot
description: Take the Bainbridge Island ferry from Seattle on foot. Check round-trip fares, walk-on boarding, holiday sailings, the free art museum and two Winslow waterfront walks.

title: Calle Ocho over coffee
description: Walk Miami’s Little Havana from Cuban Memorial Boulevard to Domino Park, Tower Theater and a Cuban coffee stop. Find park hours, trolley service and what to order.

title: The trees Chicago makes together
description: Plan Christmas Around the World at Chicago’s Museum of Science and Industry. Find six trees on the 2026 map, compare tickets and check holiday hours.

title: The two faces of Mammoth Cave
description: Compare three Mammoth Cave National Park tours by stairs, distance and ticket price. Find the winter schedule for Mammoth Passage, Frozen Niagara and Domes & Dripstones.

title: Two pools and a long evening at Hearst Castle
description: Compare Hearst Castle tour tickets in San Simeon, California. See the Neptune and Roman pools, Holiday Twilight dates, stairs, shuttle and accessible routes.

title: Where winter starts above Palm Springs
description: Plan the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway in winter. Check online fares, walk-up tickets, parking, holiday hours and closures, Long Valley snow and short hikes.

title: The trains that stayed in Brooklyn
description: Visit the New York Transit Museum in Brooklyn, compare tickets and accessibility, and find the Sunday 2026 Holiday Nostalgia Train and free Grand Central show.

title: Stay for the last light at White Sands
description: Plan a winter visit to White Sands National Park near Alamogordo, New Mexico. Compare Dunes Drive hikes, sledding slopes, $25 admission, sunset hours and the boardwalk closure.

title: Honolulu’s finish line waits
description: Plan the Honolulu Marathon on Dec. 13. The race starts at 5 a.m. and the start line closes at 5:30 a.m. Check the course, fees, 10K finish and zoo shuttle.
